title: StateSight: Benchmarking Latent Spatial-State Reconstruction in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.20414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used for multimodal question answering, yet their ability to reconstruct latent spatial structure from a single image remains difficult to isolate. Broad benchmarks often combine perception, optical character recognition, domain knowledge, linguistic priors, and reasoning in the same evaluation. We introduce StateSight, a procedurally generated benchmark for cube-net opposite-face reasoning, occluded cube-tower counting, and 4-neighbor connected-component counting. Each task family contains 300 single-image prompts with deterministic oracle labels and exact-match scoring. OpenAI GPT-5.5, using the API model identifier gpt-5.5, achieved 59.3%, 33.3%, and 28.3% accuracy across the three tasks, while Claude Sonnet 5 achieved 53.3%, 18.7%, and 7.3%. All final direct runs had zero format errors. A 30-participant human baseline on 60 items exceeded both models on every task, with mean accuracies of 80.8%

translated_title: StateSight：视觉-语言模型中潜在空间状态重建的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20414v1 公告类型：新 摘要：视觉-语言模型越来越多地用于多模态问答，但其从单张图像重建潜在空间结构的能力仍难以单独评估。广泛的基准测试通常在同一评估中结合感知、光学字符识别、领域知识、语言先验和推理。我们引入了StateSight，这是一个程序化生成的基准测试，用于立方体网络对面推理、遮挡立方体塔计数和四邻接连通分量计数。每个任务族包含300个单图像提示，具有确定性预言标签和精确匹配评分。OpenAI GPT-5.5（使用API模型标识符gpt-5.5）在三个任务上的准确率分别为59.3%、33.3%和28.3%，而Claude Sonnet 5的准确率分别为53.3%、18.7%和7.3%。所有最终直接运行均无格式错误。一项针对60个项目的30名参与者的人类基线在每个任务上都超过了这两个模型，平均准确率为80.8%。
tldr: 本文提出StateSight基准，通过程序化生成的三个空间推理任务，评估视觉-语言模型的潜在空间重建能力，发现现有模型显著落后于人类表现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces StateSight, a benchmark with three procedurally generated spatial reasoning tasks to evaluate latent spatial reconstruction in vision-language models, revealing that current models significantly underperform humans.
